votes.motion: Public hearing and recommendation of Gary Clark’s request for review of the Clark Zone Change on 1.46 acres of property located at 1460 North 1200 West, changing the zoning from A-1 (agriculture) to RA-1 (residential/agriculture).

Commissioner Carlson moved to table the application for 30 days to allow applicant time to provide a comprehensive study and to prepare a site plan that presents a solution to the traffic issues that have been experienced and incurring for the westerly building. We grant the applicant to extend to a later day if they so choose to bring a solution for Anna Black’s request for conditional use approval of the East Main Street Retail Center Conversion Site Plan with a drive-thru located in an existing building at 1325 East Main Street, changing the existing auto repair business to a retail store;
